source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Filelink checks three successive nextElementSibling values with optional chaining because missing following BR nodes are valid. If any shape test fails it skips removal; it still restores the editor selection. This supports a narrowly justified absence guard. It does not justify optional chaining on required initialized controls, and it does not establish a global syntax rule.
title: Allow optional chaining only for a valid missing structure in the insertion guard
